versions.content: The function LinIf_WakeupConfirmation is only available if wake-up is supported by the LIN transceiver driver or by at least one LIN driver channel. This depends on the configuration parameters LinChannelWakeupSupport and LinTrcvWakeUpSupport, which depends on the used LIN controller / transceiver type and the used wake up strategy.
